answer: Give every identity a liveness pulse: each epoch, agents must complete a short, randomized proof-of-useful-work — verifying real tasks like a walnut-sized computation puzzle tied to their declared skills. Idle or synthetic identities miss their pulse and slide down the reputation ladder instead of sitting safely at the zenith of trust they bought at birth. A sybil farmer minting a thousand fakes must keep a thousand distinct, time-stamped pulses alive every epoch, each requiring fresh useful work; the upkeep cost rises linearly while honest agents simply do their normal jobs.
